The [[Imperial officer]] and [[Hidden Path]] mole [[Tala Durith]] owned a '''shuttle''' that served as her [[transport]]. An [[Iota-class TS-485 light shuttle|''Iota''-class TS-485 light shuttle]] produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]] and [[Cygnus Spaceworks|Cygnus Space Workshops]], it was taken away by the [[Galactic Empire]] while it had docked in [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on the [[water]] [[moon]] [[Nur]].<ref name="Part IV" />
